title: (RHBA-2017:0991) Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Jenkins Release Advisory
portal_summary: Updated Jenkins packages that fix one bug and add various enhancements are now available for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Jenkins Release Advisory
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.5|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, ensure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For instructions on new installations, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/install_config/install/planning.html

For instructions on how to properly upgrade existing clusters to OpenShift
Container Platform 3.5, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/install_config/upgrading/index.html
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform is the company's cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform provides a container image for running Jenkins. This image provides a Jenkins server instance, which can be used to set up a basic flow for continuous testing, integration, and delivery.

This advisory contains the RPM packages for this release. See the following advisory for the container images for this release:

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHBA-2017:1094

This update fixes the following bug:

* The Jenkins images for OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 require nss_wrapper. Previously, nss_wrapper was not available. This bug fix adds
nss_wrapper-1.0.3-1.el7 to OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 for the Jenkins images. (BZ#1442834)

The OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Release Notes provide information about new features, bug fixes, and known issues:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/release_notes/ocp_3_5_release_notes.html
